title: A producer change cannot mask an undeclared assumption: with both, the reason is assumption and an approve line discharges nothing; with the producer change alone it is answerable

assert.why: A.5.4.1 [D9]: per record the first match among stale, expired, assumption, weak, producer-changed is assumption (the undeclared assume in the proof's cone), and producer change is reported only for an otherwise usable record; A.5.4.3: the law reason is assumption; A.7.2.2: affected adds implementation finest changes only when producer-changed, so Cargo.lock is not in the binding
A.7.6.5: dana's ref expands to an obligation with reason assumption, which has no answer discharger, and there is no exception (A.7.6.6)

the producer-changed answer is accepted and the re-evaluated law is Sat
